idea: A shared job board so independent design studios can track briefs, files, and approvals in one place.

customer_tests.result: No interview, signup, or payment was reported.

problem: Client briefs, files, and approvals get lost between email and spreadsheets.
who_affected: Independent design studios that run client work by hand.
workaround: Email and spreadsheets. That current habit is the competitor to beat.
solution_fit: One board would hold the brief, the files, and the approval. A studio would switch only if building that path in a general tool is slower than email.

market.basis: No census count of design studios was opened.
Independent studios are a slice of the design industry, not the whole industry.
No reachable-customer count was opened. This is not a percent of TAM.

competitors.name: Asana
competitors.strength: Work management used by many kinds of teams.
competitors.weakness: Not limited to a studio brief and approval path.
competitors.difference: The idea is only that studio path.

competitors.name: Monday.com
competitors.strength: Teams can configure their own boards.
competitors.weakness: The studio has to build the approval path.

competitors.name: Notion
competitors.strength: Flexible pages for a small team.
competitors.weakness: A blank workspace, not a client-approval path.
competitors.difference: The idea is the approval path.

community.finding: No forum or review page about this idea was opened.

checks.name: Pain
checks.evidence: A workaround is named, but no customer described the last time it failed.

checks.name: Market
checks.evidence: SOM was not taken from an opened count.

checks.name: Alternatives
checks.evidence: Three product sites were opened, and email is the status quo.

checks.name: Customer pull
checks.evidence: No interview, signup, or payment was reported.

decision_reason: Alternatives are real, and email is the habit to replace. Pain and customer pull were not shown, so this is not a go.
next_test: Talk with studio owners about the last time a client approval got lost, and ask what they would pay to stop that. Do not build the board first.

assumptions.text: TAM, SAM, and SOM are not calculated. No studio count was opened, and SOM is not a percent of an industry total.
